action_args.justification: The series is dominated by a strong upward trend (trend strength 0.993) with weak seasonality (0.088) and moderate ranking stability (Kendall tau 0.423). No single model consistently dominates across the 3 validation windows, so a trimmed mean over the 9 most stable models is well-suited: it captures the shared trend signal while trimming the occasional outlier forecast. The leader's RMSE of 104.9 is within 4% of the best single model (FT_rf, 100.6), and the runner-up margin is not statistically distinguishable, confirming that no alternative combination offers a meaningful gain.
